storyline.title: What exactly did we build?
storyline.jury_question: Is this merely a classifier demo, or is there an actual system architecture?
storyline.proof: GreenPulse contains separate vision, sensor-contract, time-sync, registry, safety-gate, active-learning, audit and hardware-contract layers.

storyline.title: How did we prevent test leakage?
storyline.jury_question: How do we know your final accuracy was not optimized against the test set?
storyline.proof: Model selection ended on validation. The final checkpoint was frozen before final-test exposure. Tomato final test was consumed once, and post-test analysis used saved predictions only.

storyline.title: Did the model actually converge?
storyline.jury_question: What happened during training, and was the reported model simply an old checkpoint?

rapid_fire.question: Why YOLO11n?
rapid_fire.answer: We selected a lightweight Ultralytics classification architecture suitable for later edge deployment. Current ONNX parity is verified; Hailo runtime is not yet validated.

rapid_fire.question: Why not use test data during model selection?
rapid_fire.answer: Because that would bias the reported final estimate. Model selection was validation-only, followed by checkpoint freeze and one-time held-out evaluation.

rapid_fire.question: Is Grad-CAM proof of disease localization?
rapid_fire.answer: No. It is a qualitative attention diagnostic only. We do not claim pixel-level lesion segmentation.

rapid_fire.question: Did transfer learning beat the baseline?
rapid_fire.answer: No demonstrated advantage was observed on validation; both candidates reached identical validation accuracy.

rapid_fire.question: Can the current system irrigate autonomously?
rapid_fire.answer: No. Physical actuation is explicitly disabled in the current research-only software state.

rapid_fire.question: What happens for cucumber?
rapid_fire.answer: Cucumber is outside the current two-crop scope and has no registered model, so routing is blocked under the abstention policy.

rapid_fire.question: Does ONNX parity mean Hailo deployment is complete?
rapid_fire.answer: No. It proves export-level consistency only. HEF conversion, Pi/Hailo latency and memory remain hardware-stage tasks.
